role_in_op: Main objective (platoon) of op 7. The north rim cliff town and the garrison of the North Narrows: the two Narrows batteries (7-M3 and its pair) are manned from here, and the rim trench (7-06) 580 m south-west links it to the Chora. The garrison holds the rim square under the signal lantern, the cliff-edge houses that overlook the Narrows and the two road entries.
approaches_text: The lagoon side is a 300 m cliff: no way up except the lanes' end stairs, which are dead ends on purpose (look-outs, not routes). Players come along the crest road from the south-east (from the Chora or the monastery), down the north road from the Oyra Head landing, or along the rim from the Narrows batteries.
